title: Tunisia vs Algeria Stock Exchanges: 75 Listings, 10 Listings, Few New Firms | The Six, Ep. 23
lede: The Bourse de Tunis had 75 listed companies at the end of 2025; the Algiers Stock Exchange has 10 after two joined in July. Two state bank listings multiplied Algiers' market value, while Tunis recorded 41 IPOs from 2008 to 2025 and none that raised money from 2023 through 2025.
keyPoints: Crédit Populaire d'Algérie's March 2024 IPO raised 112 billion dinars and took the Algiers market from 72 billion to 532 billion dinars (Bloomberg).
At June 30, 2026 the Algiers market was worth 743.64 billion dinars; CPA and BDL made up nearly 90% (COSOB via Maghreb Emergent).
Ayrade's July 2026 offer of 1.25 million shares at 800 dinars drew demand of 138% (Maghreb Emergent).
Tunis recorded 41 IPOs from 2008 to 2025, raising 1.451 billion dinars; none in 2023 or 2024, and a tax break for new listings was removed in 2025 (Bourse de Tunis study via La Presse).
The Tunindex rose 35.1% in 2025 and 38.5% in 2026 through October (Tunisie Valeurs; Challenges.tn).
